record: integrated production checkpoint; final comparative evaluation in progress
selection_basis: Frozen on the three development pages. Direct covered 1/7 answerable fields and hybrid 2/7; both missed the labeled row prices and matched the invoice total. Direct used less peak process memory and wall time. Both require review. See docs/development/evaluation-settings.md.

1_feasibility.detail: Pinned MLX image generation and the native CPU layout plus recognition pipeline each ran cold and resident under process-level external network denial. Provisioning and implementation overlapped.

3_implementation.detail: Frozen code passed 371 integrated checks, eight independent recovery probe groups, and seven SQLite round trips. All five new recovery findings and the duplicate-price multiset case closed.

4_evaluation.scope: Both real routes on identical pinned inputs, including separate development, primary held-out and handwriting diagnostic cohorts. Additional synthetic runs pending at this checkpoint.

5_review_handoff.detail: Material code findings fixed and independently rechecked. Final model measurements and handoff pending.

direct.scope: Normal offline CLI on the 800 × 420 synthetic invoice. Domain accuracy is measured separately.
